page.notes: Woodcut initials at the start of "Declamator" and "Saracenos" are decorative and transcribed as first letters. Greek words in the first paragraph (ἀ/προφήτης-type terms and the Greek forms after "verbum" and "Cretensium") are illegible at this scan resolution and are represented by ⸀. Hebrew נביא is as printed. Several words in the Ewichiique/Scribonii passage and the Alamannis "töppelen" gloss are doubtful.
